nodes.name: Every Day 08:00
nodes.notes: Fires daily at 08:00 in the workflow timezone (Asia/Dubai - largest MENA market; documented in decisions.md). Reports the previous full day.

nodes.name: Compute Window
nodes.notes: Yesterday's [00:00, 00:00) window in Asia/Dubai. Passed as named args to the case1_daily_digest RPC.

nodes.name: Fetch Digest Stats
nodes.notes: One RPC call returns the full day's aggregates as a single JSON object (no raw rows over the wire). neverError so a DB blip degrades gracefully.

nodes.name: Build Digest Message
nodes.notes: Formats the RPC aggregates into a #leads Block Kit digest. Defensive: handles RPC body returned as object or single-element array.

nodes.name: Post Digest To Slack
nodes.notes: Posts the digest to #leads via chat.postMessage (bot token). Same hardening as the M5 Slack node (4 tries / 3s / 15s).

nodes.name: Log Digest Run

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((function(){ var slack=$('Post Digest To Slack').item.json; var sb=(slack&&slack.body)?slack.body:slack; var ok=!!(sb&&sb.ok); var s=$('Build Digest Message').item.json.stats||{}; return { workflow_name:'03 - Daily Digest', execution_id:$execution.id, lead_id:null, status: ok?'success':'partial', step_name:'daily_digest', metadata:{ slack_ok:ok, window_start:s.window_start, leads_received:s.leads_received, handed_off:s.handed_off, runs_failed:s.runs_failed } }; })()) }}

nodes.notes: Terminal: records the digest run (status=partial if Slack failed).

parameters.content:
## 03 - Daily Digest
Every day 08:00 Asia/Dubai (or run manually), aggregates the PREVIOUS day via the case1_daily_digest Postgres RPC (one call, aggregation in SQL) and posts a #leads summary: leads received, intent/tier breakdown, handoffs, and run health (partial/failed + failure list). This is the safety net that surfaces degraded (partial) runs that were handled gracefully and never hit the #automation-errors channel.
